deals.description: We bought Twin Oaks, a distressed 253-unit townhome community in Southeast Memphis, in 2019 and put it through a full turnaround. That meant exterior and safety upgrades, interior renovations, and new operations and management. Today it is a stabilized community with a better resident experience.

aliceSprings.summary: Alice Springs RV Park & Resort in Ionia, Michigan is our pilot in outdoor hospitality. Greyson's principals are part of the ownership group alongside investors, and Greyson asset-manages the park.
aliceSprings.ownershipNote: Structured like our multifamily deals: principals in the ownership group alongside investors, Greyson as asset manager (Justin, 10/28).
